title: medium size towels
text: medium size towels. Purchased these for my mom as she is small and hates huge towels.  They are still bigger than she wanted, but they are less than the "standard" size these days.  I wish they were better quality.  Just because they are smaller, why can't they be really nice and thick?  Anyway.. they are towels - just thin and substandard quality.  They washed and dried with lots of lint - however, in fairness, all new towels lint pretty heavily. In my opinion they are barely rag quality.  My mom graciously uses them.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
